question: Will US mortgage rates hit 8% by end of 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the Freddie Mac Primary Mortgage Market Survey (PMMS) weekly average 30-year fixed-rate mortgage rate reaches or exceeds 8.00% in any weekly release published strictly after 2026-10-01T21:58:44.985Z and at or before 2027-01-01T08:00:00.000Z.
- "No": Wins if no PMMS weekly release published strictly after 2026-10-01T21:58:44.985Z and at or before 2027-01-01T08:00:00.000Z records a 30-year fixed-rate mortgage rate of 8.00% or above.

Clarifications:
- The rate used is the Freddie Mac PMMS weekly average 30-year fixed-rate mortgage (FRM), as published each Thursday by Freddie Mac. A single qualifying weekly release within the window is sufficient for "Yes" to win.
